links.outcome: Correctness of ChatGPT diagnostic hypotheses, recommended exams and lab tests versus physician records
links.effect: ChatGPT correct in 43% of diagnostic hypotheses, 5% of recommended supplementary exams, and 10% of laboratory tests; responses often partially accurate and unnecessarily detailed.
links.quote: When compared to physicians' records, ChatGPT provided correct responses in 43% of diagnostic hypotheses, 5% of recommended supplementary exams, and 10% of laboratory tests.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of LLMs (ChatGPT and others) retrospectively on real medical records for cardiovascular diagnosis and test recommendations, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
